The '''Vyron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] on the edges of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Annexation of the Vyron system|annexed]] the system to make up for territory lost to the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="Karagga" />
